recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2). 2. Add title text box at top: '[3] Visualize ' in dark red bold, 'Reduced Features' in blue bold, then ' [ ' + yellow-highlighted '4' + ' features are reduced to ' + yellow-highlighted 'three features' + ']' in blue bold. 3. Add circled '64' at top-right. 4. Draw a large thin red-bordered rectangle covering most of the slide below the title. 5. Upper-left inside the frame: small red-bordered box containing a column vector (W₁, L₁, W₂, L₂) in blue, a red 'PCA' label over a red double arrow ⇒, and a result column vector (Z₁, Z₂, Z₃). 6. Center: insert a 3-D scatter plot with axes Z₁ (-3 to 4), Z₂ (-1.0 to 1.5), Z₃ (-0.6 to 0.8); plot three clusters — red points left, green middle, blue right — on a light gray 3D grid; axis labels in red italics. 7. Right side inside frame: legend text 'Setosa' (red), 'Versicolor' (green), 'Virginica' (blue), stacked vertically. 8. Bottom center: caption bar 'Visualize Classes as 3-D (z₁ vs Z ₂ vs Z₃)' in blue with 'Classes' in red.
